sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve all prior repairs. The two applicability/evidence booleans are still placed at the intermediateIceFrame level, so direct-attachment cases are incorrectly forced to satisfy the horizontal-member alternative; place supportingStructureAtOrBelowIceBeltLowerLimit=true and sameScantlingsAsMainFrame=true inside the horizontal-member lower-end branch. Also add the supplied canonical mainFrameBelowIceBeltStrengthened check, requiring true only for main-frame instances applicable below the lower edge of the ice belt, not for every targeted main frame. Keep direct attachment available to both frame classes and keep the horizontal-member alternative restricted to intermediateIceFrame instances.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the conditional logic. Move supportingStructureAtOrBelowIceBeltLowerLimit=true and sameScantlingsAsMainFrame=true into the alternative lower-end branch, so an intermediate frame using direct attachment is not forced to satisfy horizontal-member evidence as well. Also constrain mainFrameBelowIceBeltStrengthened=true only to main frames below the ice-belt lower edge; it is currently mandatory for every targeted main frame and therefore overstates the applicability of the note. Preserve the permitted supporting-structure alternatives and the nested connection to an adjacent main frame.

Preserve the prior repairs, but further constrain the horizontal-member alternative to intermediateIceFrame instances only: the current second constraint permits a mainFrame to satisfy the exception by terminating below a qualifying support and connecting to an adjacent main frame, although the regulation grants that alternative only to an intermediate frame. Keep the direct-attachment alternative available to both mainFrame and intermediateIceFrame, and retain the main-frame ice-strengthening check separately and only in its below-ice-belt applicability context.

Preserve the prior repairs, but add the supplied canonical mainFrameBelowIceBeltStrengthened check for mainFrame instances below the lower edge of the ice belt, with true required only in that applicability context; it is currently omitted entirely. Keep the direct-attachment alternative available to both mainFrame and intermediateIceFrame, and keep the horizontal-member alternative restricted to intermediateIceFrame with supportingStructureAtOrBelowIceBeltLowerLimit=true and sameScantlingsAsMainFrame=true.

Preserve all prior repairs. The two applicability/evidence booleans are still placed at the intermediateIceFrame level, so direct-attachment cases are incorrectly forced to satisfy the horizontal-member alternative; place supportingStructureAtOrBelowIceBeltLowerLimit=true and sameScantlingsAsMainFrame=true inside the horizontal-member lower-end branch. Also add the supplied canonical mainFrameBelowIceBeltStrengthened check, requiring true only for main-frame instances applicable below the lower edge of the ice belt, not for every targeted main frame. Keep direct attachment available to both frame classes and keep the horizontal-member alternative restricted to intermediateIceFrame instances.
